tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: BIDDER SHOULD UPLOAD ALL RELEVANT TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS AS PER CONDITIONS MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT ATTACHED

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- BIDDER SHOULD UPLOAD ALL  RELEVANT TECHNICAL  DOCUMENTS AS PER CONDITIONS  MENTIONED IN THE TENDER  DOCUMENT ATTACHED

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A confirmation letter on the organizations letterhead stating that the tenderer has not been blacklisted by any Government or Public Sector organization
Annual Turnover Certificate from a Chartered Accountant CA certifying a minimum turnover of Rs12.00 lakhs in any one financial year during the last three years 2023-24, 2024-25,2025-26

Attach a valid Business License Certificate issued by the concerned authority, such as the Gram Panchayat, Town Panchayat, Urban Local Body, Municipality, City Corporation, Metropolitan Corporation, or Municipal Corporation
Attach details of Income Tax paid for the Financial Year 2024-25 Assessment Year 2025-26
Attach the GST payment challan for the month of March 2026

Electrical Contractors shall possess a valid official certificate issued by the Electricity Department. Alternatively, the Electrical Contractor shall submit an agreement deed executed on stamp paper, as per Form-3, with a person/agency holding a valid official certificate issued by the Electricity Department. The agreement shall include the valid official certificate of the contractor to whom the work is entrusted.
GST Registration Certificate A copy of the registration letter must be attached
Pan card copy of the tenderer
Tenderers name and full postal address and telephone number
